description: This file defines a middleware function `sessionTrackingScope` for Express.js to enforce tenant-scoped filtering on /api/session-tracking endpoints. It extracts tenant ID from the request's auth object, sets forced filters, and flags for downstream processing, ensuring multi-tenant data isolation.

methods.name: sessionTrackingScope
methods.description: Middleware enforcing tenant-scoped filtering by extracting tenant ID from request auth, setting forced filter and enforcement flags, and handling unauthorized requests.
